scientific_limitations: Exact results for a two-state symmetric telegraph switching environment, independent Gaussian forces and strictly positive complementary noise intensities.
The modulator sign is not identifiable; switching is unidentifiable at zero intensity contrast.
Population moments do not establish statistical stability under noisy finite-sample estimation.
Broad Markov-modulated OU theory contains the generic generator and conditional Gaussian representation; the exact projection-classification/inverse diagnosis is the assessed refinement.
title: Gaussian diagonal trajectories and identifiable hidden switching in a complementary-diffusivity harmonic trap
